# Printed parts

Flat 1-plate tiles (and the computer) with a picture in fixed colours. Prints read along +x at r=0.
Use them for signs, faces of robots, clocks on towers, badges on police / fire buildings and vehicles.

| part id | w x d | print | shows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `computer_1x2` | 2 x 1 | `screen` | computer screen: window, bar chart, text |
| `print_police_2x2` | 2 x 2 | `police` | navy police shield with a gold star and POLICE |
| `print_fire_2x2` | 2 x 2 | `fire` | red fire-brigade badge with a flame and FIRE |
| `print_clock_2x2` | 2 x 2 | `clock` | clock face (ten past ten) |
| `print_stop_2x2` | 2 x 2 | `stop` | red octagonal STOP sign |
| `print_arrow_2x2` | 2 x 2 | `arrow` | blue road sign, white arrow pointing +x |
| `print_menu_1x2` | 2 x 1 | `menu` | chalkboard restaurant menu |
| `print_screen_1x2` | 2 x 1 | `screen` | computer screen: window, bar chart, text |
| `print_eyes_1x2` | 2 x 1 | `robot_eyes` | dark visor with two glowing eyes |
| `print_number_1x2` | 2 x 1 | `number_112` | emergency number 112 on a white plate with a red border |
| `print_heart_1x1` | 1 x 1 | `heart` | red heart |
